Brand new dialogue for Elliott. Adds a new line for every day of the week for each heart level, gives him way more personality,
character. Makes him more kind-hearted and joyful.
And when you get higher up in hearts with him, he turns into quite the romantic! 


======================

[b]2)[/b] [b]Download the mod and unzip it
3) Drag or copy the folder into[/b] [code]Stardew Valley/Mods
[/code][b]4) Open up your game using the SMAPI launcher, or however you open up SMAPI[/b]
